metadata.title: On Correspondences between the Alexander Polynomials of Special Alternating Links and MOY Graphs
metadata.abstract: Fox's conjecture famously asserts that the absolute values of the coefficients of the Alexander polynomial of alternating links are trapezoidal. In the setting of MOY graphs, where a different notion of Alexander polynomial appears, the equivalent result to Fox's conjecture is known to hold. In this paper, we relate the two polynomials in the case of special alternating links. More precisely, we show that their degrees, first, and last coefficient agree, and that the MOY polynomial coefficients always dominate the classical Alexander polynomial.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 比较特殊交错结的经典 Alexander 多项式与 MOY 多项式，证明次数和首尾项一致及系数支配关系。
analysis.breakthrough: 把两种组合不变量的系数联系提升为逐项控制。
analysis.limitations: 系数支配本身不能推出 Fox 梯形猜想；结论仅适用于指定结类。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 为结多项式研究提供细化关系，但与本期几何核心方向间接。
